alt: 兩名戴著安全帽的學生騎車並肩接近終點線，旁邊同學為兩人加油。
scene_prompt: 鹿死誰手 means it is still uncertain who will win in the end of a close competition. On a safe closed school cycling track, two young riders race neck and neck toward the finish line, neither ahead, with classmates cheering behind. Show suspense and balanced competition without collision or traffic. Each bicycle has two aligned wheels, frame, fork, pedals and chain with plausible geometry; riders have two arms and legs, hands on handlebars, feet at pedals, track perspective coherent.
style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration, landscape 3:2, graphite pencil contours, soft watercolor and colored-pencil grain on warm ivory paper, natural sports colors. No text, numbers, logos or watermark.
